morning.title: Ayatul Kursi
morning.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
morning.translation: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
morning.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa al-hayyu al-qayyum. La ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm. Lahu ma fi al-samawati wa ma fi al-ard. Man dha alladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi idhnih. Ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum wa la yuhituna bi shay'in min 'ilmihi illa bi ma sha'. Wasi'a kursiyyuhu al-samawati wa al-ard wa la ya'uduhu hifdhuhuma wa huwa al-'aliyyu al-'adhim.
morning.virtue: Whoever recites this in the morning will be protected until evening, and whoever recites this in the evening will be protected until morning.

morning.title: The Three Quls
morning.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ﴿١﴾ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ﴿٢﴾ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ﴿٣﴾ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ﴿٤﴾ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ﴿١﴾ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ﴿٢﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ﴿٣﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ﴿٤﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ﴿٥﴾ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ﴿١﴾ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ﴿٢﴾ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ﴿٣﴾ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ﴿٤﴾ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ﴿٥﴾ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ ﴿٦﴾
morning.translation: Say, 'He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent.' Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak From the evil of that which He created And from the evil of darkness when it settles And from the evil of the blowers in knots And from the evil of an envier when he envies.' Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind, The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer - Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind - From among the jinn and mankind.'
morning.transliteration: Qul huwa Allahu ahad. Allahu samad. Lam yalid wa lam yulad. Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad. Qul a'udhu bi-rabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffathati fil 'uqad. Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad. Qul a'udhu bi-rabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas. Min sharril-waswasil-khannas. Alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas.
morning.virtue: Whoever recites these three surahs three times in the morning and evening, they will suffice him against everything.

morning.title: Sayyidul Istighfar
morning.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
morning.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no deity except You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I am faithful to my covenant and promise to You as much as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me, and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for verily none forgives sins except You.
morning.transliteration: Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa anta, khalaqtani wa ana abduka, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mas-tata'tu, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu, abu'u laka bini'matika 'alayya, wa abu'u bidhanbi faghfir li fa innahu la yaghfiru adhdhunuba illa anta
morning.virtue: Whoever says it with conviction in the morning and dies before evening will enter Paradise

morning.title: Dua for Well-being
morning.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
morning.translation: O Allah, grant me well-being in my body. O Allah, grant me well-being in my hearing. O Allah, grant me well-being in my sight. There is no deity except You.
morning.transliteration: Allahumma 'afini fi badani, Allahumma 'afini fi sam'i, Allahumma 'afini fi basari, la ilaha illa anta
morning.virtue: Seeking well-being in body, hearing, and sight

morning.title: Strong Protection (Morning)
morning.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
morning.translation: In the name of Allah, with Whose name nothing can cause harm on earth or in heaven, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
morning.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'as-mihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i, wa Huwas-Sami'ul-'Alim
morning.virtue: Whoever recites this three times in the morning and evening, nothing will harm them.

morning.title: Morning Supplication
morning.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
morning.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the final return.
morning.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna, wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilaykal-masir

morning.title: Morning Protection
morning.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
morning.translation: O Allah, grant me well-being in my body. O Allah, grant me well-being in my hearing. O Allah, grant me well-being in my sight. There is no deity except You.
morning.transliteration: Allahumma 'afini fi badani, Allahumma 'afini fi sam'i, Allahumma 'afini fi basari, la ilaha illa anta
morning.virtue: Seeking well-being in body, hearing, and sight

evening.title: Evening Remembrance
evening.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
evening.translation: We have reached the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, who has no partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is capable of all things.
evening.transliteration: Amsayna wa amsal mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir

evening.title: Ayatul Kursi (Evening)
evening.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
evening.translation: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? Ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum wa la yuhituna bi shay'in min 'ilmihi illa bi ma sha'. Wasi'a kursiyyuhu al-samawati wa al-ard wa la ya'uduhu hifdhuhuma wa huwa al-'aliyyu al-'adhim.
evening.virtue: Whoever recites this in the evening will be protected until morning.

evening.title: The Three Quls (Evening)
evening.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ﴿١﴾ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ﴿٢﴾ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ﴿٣﴾ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ﴿٤﴾ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ﴿١﴾ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ﴿٢﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ﴿٣﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ﴿٤﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ﴿٥﴾ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ﴿١﴾ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ﴿٢﴾ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ﴿٣﴾ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ﴿٤﴾ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ﴿٥﴾ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ ﴿٦﴾

Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak From the evil of that which He created And from the evil of darkness when it settles And from the evil of the blowers in knots And from the evil of an envier when he envies.' Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind, The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer - Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind - From among the jinn and mankind.'

Alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas.
evening.virtue: Whoever recites these three surahs three times in the evening, they will suffice him against everything.

evening.title: Strong Protection (Evening)
evening.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
evening.translation: In the name of Allah, with Whose name nothing can cause harm on earth or in heaven, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
evening.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'as-mihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i, wa Huwas-Sami'ul-'Alim
evening.virtue: Whoever recites this three times in the morning and evening, nothing will harm them.

evening.title: Evening Protection
evening.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
evening.translation: We have reached the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, who has no partner.
evening.transliteration: Amsayna wa amsal mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah

sleep.title: Before Sleep
sleep.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
sleep.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ would say this before sleeping

sleep.title: Protection While Sleeping
sleep.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
sleep.translation: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.

sleep.title: Protection from Nightmares
sleep.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
sleep.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and punishment, from the evil of His servants, and from the evil suggestions of the devils and from their presence.
sleep.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammat min ghadabihi wa 'iqabih, wa sharri 'ibadih, wa min hamazatish-shayatin wa an yahdhurun
sleep.virtue: Protection from nightmares and evil dreams

sleep.title: Sleep Protection
sleep.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، إِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
sleep.translation: In Your name, my Lord, I lay my side down, and by You I raise it. If You should take my soul, then have mercy upon it, and if You should return my soul, then protect it as You protect Your righteous servants.
sleep.transliteration: Bismika rabbi wada'tu janbi, wa bika arfa'uh, in amsakta nafsi farhamha, wa in arsaltaha fahfazha bima tahfazu bihi 'ibadakas-salihin

eating.title: Before Eating
eating.translation: In the name of Allah and with the blessings of Allah

eating.title: After Eating
eating.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
eating.translation: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might or power on my part.
eating.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah
eating.virtue: Whoever says this will be forgiven for their past sins

eating.title: Before Eating
eating.translation: In the name of Allah and with the blessings of Allah

hardship.title: Relief from Hardship
hardship.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
hardship.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being overpowered by men.
hardship.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dhala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal
hardship.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ would seek refuge with these words

hardship.title: Relief from Difficulty
hardship.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
hardship.translation: There is no deity worthy of worship except You; exalted are You! Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
hardship.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin
hardship.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'No Muslim makes this dua in any situation except that Allah responds to him'

hardship.title: Relief from Difficulty
hardship.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
hardship.translation: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
hardship.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin
hardship.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'No Muslim makes this dua in any situation except that Allah responds to him'

gratitude.title: Expressing Gratitude
gratitude.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
gratitude.translation: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might or power on my part.
gratitude.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah
gratitude.virtue: Whoever says this will be forgiven for their past sins

gratitude.title: Gratitude for Health
gratitude.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلًا
gratitude.translation: All praise is for Allah who saved me from that which He tested you with and who most certainly favored me over much of His creation.
gratitude.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi 'afani mimmab-talaka bihi wa faddalani 'ala kathirin mimman khalaqa tafdila

guidance.title: Seeking Guidance
guidance.translation: O Allah, guide me and grant me success.

guidance.title: Seeking Righteousness
guidance.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
guidance.translation: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and self-sufficiency.
guidance.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-huda wat-tuqa wal-'afafa wal-ghina
guidance.virtue: Comprehensive supplication for guidance and righteousness

sadness.title: Removal of Sadness
sadness.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
sadness.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and punishment, from the evil of His servants, and from the evil suggestions of the devils and from their presence.
sadness.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammat min ghadabihi wa 'iqabih, wa sharri 'ibadih, wa min hamazatish-shayatin wa an yahdhurun
sadness.virtue: Protection from nightmares and evil dreams

sadness.title: Removal of Sadness
sadness.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
sadness.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being overpowered by men.
sadness.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dhala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal
sadness.virtue: Protection from various forms of distress

protection.title: Protection from Evil
protection.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
protection.translation: I seek refuge in Allah's perfect words from the evil of what He has created.
protection.transliteration: A'udhu bi kalimati-llahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq

protection.title: Strong Protection
protection.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
protection.translation: In the name of Allah, with Whose name nothing can cause harm on earth or in heaven, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
protection.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'as-mihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i, wa Huwas-Sami'ul-'Alim
protection.virtue: Whoever recites this three times in the morning and evening, nothing will harm them.

protection.title: Protection from Evil Eye
protection.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
protection.translation: I seek refuge in Allah's perfect words from every devil, poisonous pest, and from every evil, harmful, envious eye.
protection.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min kulli shaytanin wa hammah, wa min kulli 'aynin lammah
protection.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ used to seek refuge with these words for Al-Hasan and Al-Husain

protection.title: Protection from Evil
protection.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
protection.translation: I seek refuge in Allah's perfect words from the evil of what He has created.
protection.transliteration: A'udhu bi kalimati-llahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq

anxiety.title: Removal of Anxiety
anxiety.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
anxiety.translation: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
anxiety.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin
anxiety.virtue: No Muslim makes this dua except that Allah responds to him

anxiety.title: Dua for Worry and Sorrow
anxiety.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
anxiety.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being overpowered by men.
anxiety.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dhala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal
anxiety.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ would seek refuge with these words

anxiety.title: Relief from Anxiety
anxiety.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
anxiety.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, I seek refuge in You from inability and laziness, I seek refuge in You from cowardice and miserliness, and I seek refuge in You from being overcome by debt and from being dominated by men.
anxiety.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wa a'udhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wa a'udhu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhl, wa a'udhu bika min ghalabatid-dayni wa qahrir-rijal
anxiety.virtue: Protection from various forms of distress

forgiveness.title: Master of Seeking Forgiveness
forgiveness.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ
forgiveness.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no deity except You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I am faithful to my covenant and promise to You as much as I can.
forgiveness.transliteration: Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa anta, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduka, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mas-tata't
forgiveness.virtue: Whoever recites this during the day with firm faith in it, and dies on the same day before the evening, will be from the people of Paradise.

forgiveness.title: Seeking Forgiveness
forgiveness.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
forgiveness.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this life and the next.
forgiveness.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyah fid-dunya wal-akhirah
forgiveness.virtue: Comprehensive supplication for forgiveness and well-being

general.title: Dua for Parents
general.translation: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small.
general.virtue: A way to show gratitude to parents and seek mercy for them

general.title: Dua for Knowledge
general.translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

general.title: Dua for Good Character
general.translation: O Allah, I ask You for guidance and righteousness.

travel.title: Travel Protection
travel.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ
travel.translation: O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that are pleasing to You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and fold up for us its distance.
travel.transliteration: Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadha al-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-'amali ma tardha, Allahumma hawwin 'alayna safarana hadha watwi 'anna bu'dah

travel.title: Travel Supplication
travel.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ
travel.translation: O Allah, make this journey easy for us and fold up for us its distance.
travel.transliteration: Allahumma hawwin 'alayna safarana hadha watwi 'anna bu'dah
